why: The typed-goal deliver course cannot pass on the doorway-corridor follow fixture.
That world is an island: acquisition relocates 32 blocks, lands in open ocean,
self-preservation seizes the body to escape drowning, and the goal is interrupted.
See ARCHITECTURE.md, 'The deliver course is blocked on the world, definitively'.
This fixture is a generation recipe, not a captured world. Paper builds it from
server.properties at boot, so there is no archive to lose, no hash to re-freeze,
and nothing that rots silently the way stone-recovery's trial-world.zip did.
The layer stack puts the top solid block at y=99, so the standing surface is
y=100 -- exactly where the existing course constants in verify-follow-field.mjs
already place BOT_START, TARGET_START and DELIVER_SOURCE. The course geometry is
unchanged; only the ground under it is.
